s: Dine qaddish ubo k"v seipim: omerim qaddish bekol maqom sheyyesh hepseq beseder hattepilla, vehem lo pachot miz' qaddishim bekol yom, al shem "sheba bayyom hillaltika". Veellu hem: a' achar pesuqe dezimra, sheshsham hu hepseq seder happesuqim. B' achar siyyum tepillat y"ch, shehi mitzva bipne atzmah veenah debuqa lemah shelleachareha. G' achar seder qedushshat "uba letziyyon", shehu gam ken dabar shebbiqdushsha. D' achar "ashre" lemincha, shehi mitzva bipne atzmah, shekkol haomer "tehilla ledavid" bekol yom g' peamim — mubtach lo shehu ben olam habba. Hashem achar siyyum tepillat y"ch shel mincha, shehi mitzva bipne atzmah. V' achar berakot shel qeriat shema shel arbit, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman rl"v. Z' achar tepillat arbit, shekkebar nishlema hattepilla. Vez' ellu hen choba keshemmitpalelin betzibbur, vehashshear minhag. Verauy lekol adam lizzaher shello lipchot millaanot y' qaddishim bekol yom:

Kol dabar shebbiqdushsha kegon qaddish u"bareku" uqedushsha — en omerim bepachot measara, shenneemar: "veniqdashti betok bene yisrael", ulehallan neemar: "hibbadelu mittok haeda vego'", ulemedin gezera shava "tok" "tok", mah "tok" haamur lehallan eda — ap "tok" haamur kan eda, veen eda pechuta measara, shenneemar: "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot", tze mehem yehoshua vekaleb — nisharu asara. Veeda zo tzarik lihyot kullah mizzekarim bene chorin gedolim shehebiu b' searot, ukemo shehayeta eda haamura lehallan. Abal nashim vaabadim uqetannim — enan mitztorpin:

Im hitchil lomar qaddish o qedushsha baasara veyatzeu miqtzatam — gomerin oto haqqaddish o otah haqqedushsha shehitchil, vehu shennishtayyeru rubba[n]. Umikkol maqom abera hi latzet, vaalehem neemar: "veozebe Hashem yiklu". Abal im nisharu asara — muttar latzet:

Velo shehitchil haqqedushsha atzmah, ella apillu hitchil birkot "abot" beqol ram veyatzeu miqtzatan — gomer apillu qedushsha vekol tepillat y"ch veseder qedushshat "uba letziyyon" veqaddish shelleachareha shello baasara, shekkol zeh miggemar tepillat y"ch hu, ulekak en sheliach tzibbur omer qaddish shalem ad achar seder qedushsha zo, veoto qaddish shalem chozer al tepillat y"ch, shehare omer "titqabbel tzelotehon veku'". Umikkol maqom im hu yom hakkenisa — en qorin battora im haleku miqtzatan qodem shehitchilu liqrot, shehaqqeria enah miggemar hattepilla, shehare bemincha qorin qodem hattepilla. Veken im yatzeu miqtzatan leachar shehitchilu "yotzer" — lo yatchil hashsheliach tzibbur lehitpallel hattepilla beqol ram, shettepillat y"ch uqedushsha en lahem inyan im qaddish u"bareku". Veken kayyotze bazeh bearbit lo yomar haqqaddish shelleachar tepillat y"ch ella im ken hayu asara bitchillat tepillat y"ch, velo day bemah shehayu asara bishat qeriat shema ubirkoteha. Abal qaddish shellipne tepillat y"ch yomar keshehayu asara bitchillat arbit ap al pi sheyyatzeu miqtzatan achar kak. Veqaddish shelleachar "alenu" ben beshacharit ben bearbit — lo yomar ella im ken yesh asara bishat amirat haqqaddish. Vaapillu hayu asara bishat amirat "alenu" — en zeh moil laqqaddish shelleacharayv, hoil veeno ella minhag lomar qaddish achar "alenu" velo mittaqqanat chakamim hu. Vehu haddin baqqaddish sheomerim achar hallimmud — tzarik sheyyihyu asara bishat amirat haqqaddish. Vehu haddin im hayu asara baamirat pesuqe dezimra, o baamirat "ashre" shellipne tepillat hammincha, veachar kak yatzeu miqtzatan qodem shehitchil haqqaddish — lo yatchilennu bepachot measara, sheap sheqqaddish zeh hu mittaqqanat chakamim shessidderu hattepilla, mikkol maqom kevan shello yukal lomar bareku o tepillat y"ch achar qaddish zeh kemo shessidderu chakamim — en qaddish zeh choba kelal, shettaqqanat chakamim hayeta lomar qaddish u"bareku" semukim zeh lazeh, umittaam zeh asur lehapsiq benehem beshum inyan kemo shennitbaer besiman n"d, veken bemincha taqqanatam hayeta lomar qaddish lipne tepillat y"ch, shelleolam en matchilin tepillat y"ch kak belo qaddish lepaneha, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rtz"b:

Yesh mattirin lomar dabar shebbiqdushsha bet' vetzerup ebed o ishsha o qatan, lepi sheal kol asara bene berit hashshekina shora, ella sheeno kebod shamayim lomar dabar shebbiqdushsha bepachot mit' bene mitzvot shet' nirim kaasara, ubilbad sheyyihyeh haqqatan yoter mibben v' shana veyodea lemi mitpallelin, sheppachot mibben shesh ap al pi sheyyodea — en dato kelum, shehare lo higgia leonat happeutut, vahare hu kemo sheeno ben daat. Veyesh omerim sheen ishsha veebed o qatan mitztorpim beshum inyan, ella tzarik sheyyehu kol asara zekarim bene chorin gedolim shehebiu b' searot, ubepachot mikken — en hashshekina shora, veen omerim dabar shebbiqdushsha. Vaapillu al yede seper tora shebbeyad haqqatan — en letzorpo. Veken iqqar. Veap al pi ken en limchot beotan shennohagin lehaqel bishat haddechaq letzorpo al yede chummash shebbeyado, o apillu belo chummash, kevan sheyyesh lahem al mi sheyyismeku. Umikkol maqom lo yomru ella "bareku" veqaddish shehu chiyyub, abal lo qaddish sheachar "alenu" sheeno ella minhag:

Im lo hebi b' searot apillu hu gadol beshanim — dino keqatan, ad sheyyetzeu rob shenotayv dehaynu l"v shana, sheaz nitbarer shehu saris velo yabi searot leolam. Veim nira bo simane saris qodem laken — dino kegadol mibben esrim shana vamala. Umikkol maqom en tzarik libdoq bassearot bekol shehiggia liklal shenotayv, dehaynu ben y"g shana veyom echad, shekkevan shettepilla middibre soperim — somekin al hachazaqa shemmin hassetam hebi b' searot, kevan shehiggia liklal shenotayv sherauy lehabi bahen b' searot:

Im hitchil echad measara lehitpallel tepillat y"ch lebaddo veeno yakol laanot immahem — ap al pi ken mitztarep immahem. Vehu haddin leb' o g' o d', kol shennishar harob sheonin amen — en aniyyat hammiut meakkebet, sheen amirat dabar shebbiqdushsha baasara taluy baaniyyatan raq sheyyihyu sham, shenneemar: "veniqdashti betok bene yisrael", al kol asara shehem bene qedushsha — shekina shora alehem, vikolim lomar dabar shebbiqdushsha (kegon qaddish u"bareku", o apillu qedushsha im hashsheliach tzibbur lo hitpallel adayin belachash leatzmo. Abal keshehashsheliach tzibbur chozer hattepilla paam b' — tzarik lizzaher sheyyihyu t' shomein veonin amen acharayv, shello yihyeh birkotayv lebattala, kemo sheyyitbaer siman qk"d):

Veyesh omerim shehu haddin im echad mi' yashen — mitztarep ledabar shebbiqdushsha ap al pi sheeno oneh immahem, abal yoter meechad — en kebod shamayim letzorpam im hem yeshenim. Veyesh omerim sheen ledammot yashen lemitpallel, lepi shehayyashen nishmato mistalleqet mimmennu veen qedushsha shora alayv, veepshar sheruach hattuma shora alayv apillu kesheyyashen bayyom kemo shennitbaer besiman d'. Uleinyan maaseh — en lehaknis et atzmo lemachaloqet, kevan sheepshar lahaqitzo:

Kesheadam mitpallel lebaddo ap al pi sheyyesh asara bilado — nakon sheyyamtinu millomar qaddish ad sheyyigmor kede sheyyizkeh gam hu. Abal im mitpallel immahem umaarik bitpillato — en tzarik lehamtin alayv, kemo sheyyitbaer siman qk"d:
Umi sheyyashen beshaa shehatztzibbur maggiin ledabar shebbiqdushsha — nakon sheyyamtinu ad sheyyeoreruhu mishshenato. Veim lo ratza laamod — en tzarik lehamtin:

Cheresh hamdabber veeno shomea o shomea veeno medabber — hen kepiqchim, umitztorpim lekol dabar shebbiqdushsha ap al pi sheen onin immahem. Vaapillu hem b' o yoter, kol sheharob hem piqchim sheyyekolim laanot amen — en aniyyat hammiut meakkebet kol shehem bene mitzvot vehashshekina shora alehem, ella sheim hashsheliach tzibbur hitpallel kebar belachash — lo yachazir hattepilla shenit ella im ken yesh t' hashshomeim veonin amen kemo sheyyitbaer siman qk"d. Abal mi sheeno shomea velo medabber — hare hu keshoteh veqatan, vezehu cheresh sheddibberu bo chakamim bekol maqom:
Leolam hu qatan ad sheyyabi b' searot achar sheyyihyeh ben y"g shana veyom echad, abal qodem laken ap al pi shehebi b' searot — eno ella shuma:

Mi shennolad beyom rishon shel rosh chodesh kislev shehu yom l' shel marcheshvan ubishnat y"g chodesh marcheshvan chaser verosh chodesh kislev eno ella yom echad — ap al pi ken eno naaseh bar mitzva ad rosh chodesh kislev, sheap al pi shellechodashim veshanim monin miyyom b' shel rosh chodesh shehu iqqar veyom a' hu min chodesh shellepanayv, mikkol maqom adayin lo maleu y"g shanim shelemot miyyom el yom ad sheyyaabru k"t yomin shelemim mimmarcheshvan, kemo shennolad achar sheaberu kebar k"t yom:

Abaryan sheabar al gezerat hatztzibbur sheggazeru benidduy vecherem o sheabar abera shennitchayyeb aleha nidduy — mitztarep leminyan asara lekol dabar shebbiqdushsha, shenneemar beakan "chata yisrael", ap al pi shechata — yisrael hu ubiqdushshato hu omed velo yatza mikkelal yisrael. Abal im nidduhu meetzlam — eno mitztarep lekol dabar shebbiqdushsha, sheim mitztarep mah hoilu betaqqanatam shehibdiluhu meaguddatam. Umikkol maqom muttar lehitpallel bebet hakkeneset shehu sham, kevan sheyyesh asara bilado, ella im ken pereshu lehachamir alayv bekak:

Tzarik sheyyihyu kol haasara bemaqom echad usheliach tzibbur immahem, abal im miqtzatam becheder zeh umiqtzatam becheder acher — enam mitztorpim ap al pi shehappetach patuach benehem. Vaapillu im harob omedim bebet hakkeneset vehammiut baazara shellipne bet hakkeneset — enam nigrarim achar harob lehitztarep immahem. Vaapillu haomedim al haasquppa betok happetach min haagap velachutz, dehaynu keshessoger haddelet mimmeqom sapa happenimit shel obi haddelet velachutz — kelachutz, shehaddelet mabdelet ben penim lechutz, veap al pi shehi petucha — hare meqomah kelachutz (velo meqom obyah bilbad, ella kol meqom chapipatah shehi chopepet al haasquppa ad maqom shehi noqeshet bo, kegon shehaddelet qebua beemtza obi haasquppa vesobebet al tzirah mitztzad penim letzad chutz ad keneged hatztzir — hare kol obi haasquppa missapa happenimit ad meqom hanneqisha shehu keneged hatztzir — hakkol kelachutz):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaomedim bachutz enam nirim lehaomedim bipnim, abal mi shemmareh panayv lehaomedim bebet hakkeneset, apillu hu omed achore bet hakkeneset umareh lahem panim derek challon shebbenehem, apillu gaboah kamma qomot, apillu eno rachab d' — mitztarep immahem laasara. Abal mi sheeno mareh panim lahem, apillu omed al gabbehen milmala al gag bet hakkeneset — eno mitztarep immahem, ben sheomed al haggag mammash ben sheomed al obi hakketalim shel bet hakkeneset, sheggam obi hakketalim enam nigrarim achar tokam lihyot niddon kilpanim ap al pi sheeno mareh panayv lahem:

Im miqtzatan mibbipnim umiqtzatan bachutz usheliach tzibbur al gabbe haasquppa tok happetach — hu metzorpan, mippene shehu roeh ellu veellu, vahare zeh keillu miqtzat haomedim bachutz nirim lemiqtzat haomedim bipnim — shehem mitztorpin:

Chatzer qetanna shennipretza bemilluah laggedola, dehaynu shennipretza qetanna bimqom chibburah laggedola venapal kol oto kotel shehaya mapsiq ubaggedola nishara mishsheerit kotel zeh passin mikkan umikkan — hare haggedola kemupleget min haqqetanna al yede happassin shemmikkan umikkan, shehen moilim lechalleq hareshuyyot (im en benehem yoter meeser ammot), sheapillu chatzer achat sheheemid bah pas mashshehu mikkan upas mashshehu mikkan beemtza kotle orkah — nitchalleqa lishte reshuyyot lekol dabar kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shs"g, vehaqqetanna enah mupleget min haggedola shehare en lah passin mikkan umikkan, vahare hi keqeren zaviyyot shel haggedola. Lepikak im t' baggedola veechad baqqetanna — mitztarep immahem, shehaqqetanna nigreret achar haggedola, vahare zeh keillu hu betok haggedola kevan sheharob baggedola. Abal im t' baqqetanna veechad baggedola — en mitztarep immahem, sheen haggedola nigreret achar haqqetanna, vehem enam nigrarim acharayv kevan shehemma harabbim. Vaapillu hayu mechetza al mechetza h' baqqetanna veHashem baggedola — enan mitztorpin, sheen nigrar ella hammiut achar harob:

Haya sheliach tzibbur baqqetanna vetzibbur baggedola — motzian yede chobatan, shehu nigrar acharehem. Abal im sheliach tzibbur baggedola vetzibbur baqqetanna — en motzian yede chobatan, sheen harob nigrar achar hayyachid:

(Vekol zeh keshenniknasim kotle orek haqqetanna letok haggedola umuplagim sham g' tepachim mikkotle orek haggedola, sheim lo ken gam haqqetanna hi kemupleget min haggedola al yede passe haggedola, mishshum nireh bachutz veshaveh mibbipnim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"s):

Bimqomot shehashsheliach tzibbur omed beteba o bebima, ap al pi shehi geboha y' tepachim urechaba d' al d' o yoter veyesh lah mechitztzot gebohot y' tepachim o yoter — mitztarep immahem umotziam yede chobatan, mippene shehi betela legabbe bet hakkeneset. Veap al pi shehi reshut bipne atzmah leinyan amida bipne seper tora kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman rp"b, mikkol maqom betela hi legabbe bet hakkeneset leinyan zeh shemmitztorpin, hoil vehu tashmish bet hakkeneset veragle bene bet hakkeneset betokah, veod kevan sheroin ellu et ellu — mitztorpin, kemo shennitbaer leel:

Vekol zeh leinyan tzerup o lehotzi yede choba, abal im hayu asara bemaqom echad veomerim qaddish o qedushsha — yakol laanot immahem kol hashshomea qolam, apillu hu bebayit acher legamre, vaapillu kamma battim mapsiqim benehem, mippene sheapillu mechitztza shel barzel enah mapseqet ben yisrael laabihem shebbashshamayim. Veyesh omerim shemmikkol maqom tzarik shello yihyeh mapsiq tinnup o aboda zara shehi chashuba ketzoa leinyan zeh. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem. Veken leinyan lehotzi yede choba lo ameru shetztzarik sheyyihyeh bemaqom echad ella hashsheliach tzibbur im hatztzibbur, abal keshehem bemaqom echad — yakol latzet kol hashshomea qol hashsheliach tzibbur ap al pi sheeno immahem veal derek shennitbaer, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman ra"g vetar"tz:

Ir sheen bah ella asara veechad mehem rotzeh latzet beyamim noraim kopin oto lishshaer o liskor acher bimqomo shekkevan shemminhag hu bekol teputzot haggola sheapillu otam sheen lahem minyan shalem kol hashshana sokerim lahem echad o shenayim beyamim noraim o holekim limqom minyan hare zeh domeh leseper tora ubet hakkeneset shebbene hair kopin zeh et zeh abal im hem y"a yakol echad latzet veen chosheshin shemma yitztarek echad latzet linqabayv veyitztareku lehamtin sheim ken en laddabar sop. Veim b' rotzim latzet shenehem sokerim echad beshuttaput lehashlim hamminyan bimqomam ushenehem yipreu beshaveh apillu echad ani veechad ashir kevan shekkol echad chayyab lehashlim hamminyan ani kemo ashir. Abal im en darin bayyishshub ella ch' o t' vesokerim lahem a' o b' lehashlim hamminyan porein chatzi lepi mamon vachatzi lepi nepashot ki yesh sebara lomar sheheani chayyab behashlamat hamminyan kemo heashir veyesh sebara lomar sheheani yakol lelek lair hassemuka veheashir eno yakol laazob beto urekusho al ken asu peshara zot mah sheen ken kesheddarin kan minyan shalem en echad mehem rashshay lebattel hamminyan apillu yelek hu lair sheyyesh bah minyan:

Kol hayyotzeim beinyan shetztzerikim liskor acher bimqoman tzerikin gam ken litten liskar sheliach tzibbur keillu lo yatzeu vaapillu mi sheyyotze zeman arok lipne yom tob tzarik litten liskar hashsheliach tzibbur vehashlamat hamminyan kemo sheyyotze samuk leyom tob kevan shello yachazor beyom tob lebeto. Umi sheeno yakol lachazor lebeto mechamat ones sheeno rashshay labo bammedina patur apillu higgia zeman haregel vehu shehu anus mammash abal im mechamat chob mamon o peshia lo yakol labo lo yapsidu chaberayv chelqam:

En kopin liskor lehashlim hamminyan ella beyamim noraim ukegon sheen chaserim ella a' o b' ella im ken minhag qabua bair lakop liskor apillu bechesron g' o d' abal im yesh minyan shalem miyyoshebe hair kopin liskor sheliach tzibbur vaapillu kol hashshana kede lehitpallel sham tamid baasara veken maqom sheen minyan tamid bebet hakkeneset kopin zeh et zeh biqnasot sheyyabou tamid minyan lebet hakkeneset shello yitbattel hattamid:

Yishshubim shetztzerikim liskor minyan usheliach tzibbur veyesh sebibot shergilin labo gam ken sham im bene betam en tzarik litten kelum lehayishshub sheim hayu rotzim hayu holekim leir acheret sheyyesh sham minyan biladam velo hayu tzerikim litten kelum apillu liskirut hashsheliach tzibbur kevan sheggam biladam hem tzerikim sham lishliach tzibbur:
